'''TOTOLINK''''s Linux driver is for the MT7601 - the MT7610 USB ID doesn't seem to be in the driver, though (7650 is..). The QIG also shows the '''Ralink''' / '''MTK''' WLAN utility, so it's assumed this thing is indeed '''MTK''' based.
